skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to task dir (`tasks/<id>/`), never to host's `/root/` — verifier only stages task dir to `<stage>/root/`.
ALWAYS read `tests/test_outputs.py` before writing output — it defines schema, field names, tolerance, and paths.
skillsbench-host-grading.description: How SkillsBench host verification works — where deliverables must live, what the verifier checks, and common pitfalls.
